clock_source: First UTC observed after user P1 authorization; planning text before it unmeasured.
authority: runtime 選 A，預算同意，保護區 A、B 授權，開始 P1

source.role: real whole character, NO_SHIP baseline; opened read-only, never saved

question: Can the selected runtime display and measure pose-driven and state-driven corrective morphs on the real character, evaluated after animation blending, with one owner per morph channel?

preregistered.probe_data: Existing authored data only: 61-frame bone action RO_WristGrip_Prototype_61f, WristLoft.R in-between keys WristVolume_025/050/075/100, glove.R key GripContact_R. No mesh, weight, bone or shape edits.
preregistered.rule_body: p = clamp(1 - angle(q_rel(hand.R), q_target)/angle(identity, q_target), 0, 1), q_rel = rest-relative local rotation, q_target = authored frame-61 value; in-between hat weights at p=0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0 for WristVolume_*. Probe rule for wiring only, not an accepted general corrective.
preregistered.rule_contact: GripContact_R weight = interaction state grasp.R in [0,1], set per sample independently of pose.
preregistered.rule_fidelity_check: Rule weights at integer frames 1..61 compared with authored time-curve values; max abs difference <= 1e-3.
preregistered.blend_sample: Two paused actions (frame 1 and frame 61) at weights 0.5/0.5; reference pose = per-bone slerp/lerp at 0.5; expected p~0.5. Proves evaluator reads the blended final pose.
preregistered.measured_quantity: World position of every exported vertex of all skinned meshes after runtime morph+skin (CPU), mapped to Blender vertex via exported original-ID attribute, versus Blender depsgraph-evaluated position of the same ID.
preregistered.wiring_gate_rationale: Wiring faults (wrong channel, order, bone, axis) give mm-cm errors; Blender exporter drops skin weights <=1e-4 (observed in r010, up to 7.895um on a hand), so um-level residue is expected and is not a wiring fault.
preregistered.precision_tier_rule: Reported only. The 1um same-version readback tolerance stays unchanged for later delivery gates and is not claimed by P1 unless actually met.
preregistered.half_frames: Reported separately from integer frames; same gate.
preregistered.channel_ownership: runtime-owner GLB must contain no weights animation channel; baked-owner GLB contains them and is evaluated with the runtime evaluator off against the authored time-curve reference.
negative_controls: NC1 evaluator off at frame 61 must exceed the gate
NC2 evaluator fed stale pose (previous sample) must exceed the gate
NC3 baked-owner GLB loaded in runtime-owner mode must fail the ownership check
NC4 rule naming a bone absent from the skeleton must raise, not evaluate to 0
preregistered.images: Blender and runtime renders from the same orthographic camera at p=0, partial, 1; qualitative only, CPU points are not GPU-frame evidence.
